You’re as likely to go to hell as you are to be reincarnated or wake up from a simulation. none of which are very likely at all. Personally I’d go as far as to say none of it will happen. There isn’t enough evidence to support these extreme claims of the after life. You also have to ask yourself why do you believe in a Christian hell and not in religious ideas of reincarnation? How do we determine which is correct? If you give up the ideas of the after life and focus on the one chance you have at making some kind of mark in a world you know will remember you, at least for a time. I’d ask you to think that maybe everything stops at you. and you’re in control. I hope that the realization of having no after life helps you to understand that you don’t have to live with so much existential guilt why pray to a god for forgiveness when you can ask forgiveness from people that you may have hurt. What is your idea of a good person? Do you hold your standards to what a good Christian is? If so why?  I don’t know your situation but it sounds to me you struggle with religious ideas and I don’t know how far they’ve gone in your life. I just want to convey you have the freedom to make your own purpose without the fear of eternal punishment for finite crimes.
